title: Raw tensor restriction commutes with scalar normalization
statement: The explicit scalar coordinate of a raw residue restriction equals the appTop image under the residue lift of its original scalar coordinate, for a framed degree-zero module and an inclusion of opens.

source.place: Tag 0096, composition of tensor adjunctions; Tag 0BF2, residue degree-zero calculation

proof.text: Write L_g for tensorPullback g and epsilon_g for the pinned tensor-unit isomorphism. For i≫g=g′ let A_g:L_g′≅L_g⋙L_i be exactly the comparison defining raw restriction. Apply the direct adjunction homEquiv to A_g.hom.app O≫L_i.map epsilon_g≫epsilon_i. The mate unit equation, naturality, pushforwardComp and pushforwardCongr give g-sharp followed by g_*(i-sharp), which is g′-sharp sectionwise. The defining adjunct of epsilon_g′ is the same, hence injectivity gives A_g.hom.app O≫L_i.map epsilon_g≫epsilon_i=epsilon_g′.

Let n=epsilon_t.inv≫f≫L_s.map q.hom≫epsilon_s. Naturality of A_s with respect to q, followed by the compatibility from step 1 for t and s, identifies the normalized raw restriction with epsilon_i.inv≫L_i.map n≫epsilon_i. The tensor-unit adjunction calculation evaluates this endomorphism at one as i.appTop(n(1)). Thus only the ring-map evaluation remains.

theorem picardTensorFrame_restriction_normalized (W : Scheme.{v}) (w : W) (U : W.Opens) (hwU :
    w ∈ U)
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ) (q :
    (Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj (K.X 0) ≅ Modules.unit U.toScheme) (V : W.Opens) (hwV : w
    ∈ V) (hVU : V ≤ U) (hs : picardResidueLift W w V hwV ≫ W.homOfLE hVU = picardResidueLift W
    w U hwU) (f : (Modules.tensorPullback V.ι).obj (Modules.unit W) ⟶ (Modules.tensorPullback
    (W.homOfLE hVU)).obj ((Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj (K.X 0))) :
    Modules.picardTensorScalarCoordinate (W.fromSpecResidueField w) (picardResidueLift W w U
    hwU) q (picardOrdinaryModelRestriction W U K (picardResidueLift W w V hwV) V.ι
    (W.fromSpecResidueField w) (W.homOfLE hVU) (picardResidueLift W w U hwU)
    (picardResidueLift_comp W w V hwV) hs f) = (picardResidueLift W w V hwV).appTop
    (Modules.picardTensorScalarCoordinate V.ι (W.homOfLE hVU) q f)
